description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which provides a structure for a logging system that can output logs to one or multiple targets. It specifies a method for printing log data, potentially allowing chaining of log nodes for flexible logging behavior.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface for a logging component capable of outputting log messages to a target or chain of targets.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to instruct the first LogNode in the chain to print the provided log data, with parameters for priority, tag, message, and an optional Throwable.
